_comment: Utah 2027 QAP, Utah Housing Corporation (dated 4/7/2026). Page numbers are PDF page indices, matching the printed numbers. Scoring is Section 8, 'The Scoring Process', pp.59-76. UTAH SCORES BY WEIGHT: each category is scored in raw points, then multiplied by a weight, x50 for the Preference criterion and x20 for the five Secondary criteria. Every criterion here is stored at its WEIGHTED value with scoring_unit 'weighted', because the document states each category's maximum in weighted terms and ranks on weighted scores. The raw maximum and weight are in each note, and the raw value of each tier is in its label. Never compare these values with another state's points. Hand-checked against each stated category maximum before loading: A Lower Income Targeting 100 x 50 = 5,000 (stated 5,000). Location 5 + 5 + 5 = 15 x 20 = 300 (stated 300). Project Characteristics 4 + 10 + 3 + 5 + 2 + 0.5 + 2 = 26.5 x 20 = 530 (stated 530, but the page also states 'Sum of Subtotals 30.5'; see B.6.c). Applicant Characteristics 10 x 20 = 200 (stated 200). Special Housing Needs 5 + 10 + 10 = 25 x 20 = 500 (stated 500). Credit Efficiency 12 x 20 = 240 (stated 240). NO GRAND TOTAL IS STATED ANYWHERE IN THE QAP. The loader's computed 6,770 is only the sum of the stated category maxima, and must not be presented as a Utah figure. The table of contents lists 'H. Preliminary Scores ... Error! Bookmark not defined.' with no G, and the body has no such section. Thresholds (Project Selection Process, pp.27-30, plus Exhibit 8E's credit-efficiency minimum) are in UT_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: No grand total stated. Category maxima are stated in weighted units: 5,000 / 300 / 530 / 200 / 500 / 240.

criteria.note: Raw maximum 100 x weight 50 = 5000 weighted. Standard election: Low below 40% AMI, Mid 40-45%, Upper over 45% to 50%. Income Averaging election: Mid is 30% of units at 40% AMI plus 30% at 50%, Low 10% at 20% plus 10% at 30%, Upper 6% at 60%, 6% at 70% and 8% at 80%. 100% Supportive Housing projects receive the full 5,000 regardless of tiering (p.61), and so can resyndications meeting the stated test.

criteria.native_category: Secondary Selection Criteria: E. Credit Efficiency
criteria.heading: Credit Efficiency
criteria.quote: Each project’s credit efficiency will be calculated at two levels:
criteria.note: Raw maximum 12 x weight 20 = 240 weighted. The average of two scores, credits per LIHTC bedroom and credits per LIHTC unit, against published averages (Exhibit 8E), so half-steps occur (the example gives 9, weighted 180). Exhibit 8E (p.155) sets a minimum of 1.5 credit efficiency points; it is in UT_thresholds.json.

criteria.note: Lowest ratio of Housing Credits requested per NRSF of Housing Credit units wins. Applied in each set-aside pool, then in the General Pool.
